en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a railway station building in a wooded valley. A steam locomotive with carriages stands at the platform, with people gathered in front of the station. Dense forested hills rise behind the station, and another larger building is visible on the slope. Printed German text in the upper-right corner reads "Zöblitz i. Erzgeb. Bahnhof" indicating the local station in the Ore Mountains.
